stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: Acorn must be in position 1. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Acorn and Beacon must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Acorn must not be in position 1.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 1 such orders. "Acorn and Beacon must not occupy consecutive positions." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- Acorn → Estuary → Dune → Beacon → Crest

distractorRationale.d: Even with the additional condition, Acorn → Estuary → Dune → Beacon → Crest is permitted and makes this statement false.
